newsitem.title: USA: AIG invests in Alcohol Sensors.
newsitem.headline: AIG invests in Alcohol Sensors.

text.p: American International Group Inc has made an investment in Alcohol Sensors International Ltd, ASI said Monday.

ASI, developers and marketers of safety devices that help prevent drinking and driving, said AIG, through a subsidiary, had invested $2.5 million in convertible preferred stock of ASI in order to support the company.

ASI manufactures the SENS-O-LOCK Breath Alcohol Ignition Interlock Safety Device, which requires a driver to provide an alcohol-safe breath sample prior to starting his vehicle and at random intervals while driving.

"AIG is making a significant investment in Alcohol Sensors International to strengthen our financial position and assure adequate marketing support for the launch of a new line of SENS-O-LOCK Alcohol Specific Technology products commencing in January 1997," said Robert Whitney, ASI president and CEO.
